reason: 0.2.2 ships a rebuilt plugin manager page (rich-text details, third-party package updates, install diagnostics, hot-update rollback). Two managers on the same settings surface will fight over routes and slot registrations.
0.2.2 renames the custom plugin market to '自定义插件索引' (custom plugin index) and reads user index files from the discovery page; the official page owns the same route.
Community index/discovery UI overlaps the official plugin index page; keep only if you still need its non-official feed, and expect duplicate entries.
Agent presets are an official surface in 0.2.2; a third-party preset browser duplicates navigation and can shadow official preset storage.
Official skill UI exists; keep the explorer only if it adds filesystem browsing the official page lacks.
0.2.2 adds ja/es/fr/de/ru/pt-BR interface text officially; a community locale pack may override or conflict with official locale keys.
The desktop app owns update download/install. A plugin update page cannot drive electron-updater correctly and can mislead about install state.
Official per-turn/step statistics are experimental and narrower than a billing-style usage history; overlap is partial.
Release note: the Git worktree entry is merged into 'Change requests and worktrees' (forge); the standalone plugin must be removed from dsh.profile.bundles by hand.
